title: Paper & Pixel
summary: A fictional small-studio portfolio built as an editorial index with numbering, cropped thumbnails and type-led transitions.

cover.alt: Paper & Pixel studio index on ivory paper: masthead with wordmark, nav and a Motion toggle; an italic lede above three numbered ruled rows (01 Atlas Identity, 02 Signal Journal, 03 Margins Press); the second row is hovered, so the sticky lightbox on the right shows the Signal Journal plate — a halftone dot matrix with an enlarged row of ultramarine squares.

desktop.alt: The same editorial index at rest: the lightbox defaults to the Atlas Identity plate — ultramarine contour rings interrupted by a grid of squares with a salmon survey marker — beside the three numbered work rows.

tablet.alt: Tablet view of the index: the numbered rows keep the left column while the sticky lightbox plate narrows into the right margin; masthead meta wraps onto one line above the ruled rows.

mobile.alt: Mobile single-column index: the masthead wraps to two lines, each numbered row carries its own small cropped plate thumbnail on the right of the title, and the footer colophon closes the page.
